احتوشن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَوَشْنَ (iḥtawašna) /iħ.ta.waʃ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اُحْتُوِشْنَ (uḥtuwišna) /uħ.tu.wiʃ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
# اِحْتَوِشْنَ (iḥtawišna) /iħ.ta.wiʃ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَوَشَ (iḥtawaša)
